name: uParcel Singapore

scam_info.sample: The Singapore Police Force's Scam Public Education Office alerted us to this uParcel scam on 31 October 2026 ... uParcel never asks for cash or payment by SMS or WhatsApp.
scam_info.notes: Dated alert (datePublished 04 Nov 2026; sitemap lastmod 2026-10-31) on iMessage phishing with lookalike uParcel sites. No concrete fake URLs/numbers. Official channels stated: website uparcel.sg ('A link that isn't uparcel.sg ... is off'), email express@uparcel.sg, uParcel app (App Store/Google Play), SMS only from 'the official uParcel sender ID'.

scam_info.sample: How to avoid falling victim to Cash on Delivery (COD) scams
scam_info.notes: Older generic blog explainer (datePublished 25 Aug 2021); content not analysed further.

apps: uParcel app (App Store / Google Play; homepage download link https://onelink.to/u2tsrn)

notes: official_domains: uparcel.sg is (a) stated in the scam alert ('Go to uparcel.sg by typing it into your browser') and (b) serving domain. sms_sender_ids 'uParcel' is inferred from 'Our SMS always come from the official uParcel sender ID' (exact string not printed). Blog sitemap (blog-sitemap.xml, lastmod per URL) is the discovery endpoint; 3 scam/protection posts. No hotline published (contact via email/app). onelink.to is a third-party link service (FQDN only in apps note).
